query:
UPDATE users
        SET email = 'deleted-' || id || '@deleted.invalid',
            avatar_key = NULL,
            password_hash = NULL,
            display_name = 'Utilisateur supprimé',
            age_declared_at = NULL,
            terms_accepted_version = NULL,
            terms_accepted_at = NULL,
            reactivation_refused_at = NULL,
            deleted_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
